verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā vesāliyaṁ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṁ.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Vesālī, at the Great Wood, in the hall with the peaked roof.

verses.pali: Atha kho aññataro vajjiputtako bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho so vajjiputtako bhikkhu bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then a certain Vajji monk went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to him:
“Sir, each fortnight over a hundred and fifty training rules are recited.
I’m not able to train in them.”

verses.pali: “Sakkhissasi pana tvaṁ, bhikkhu, tīsu sikkhāsu sikkhituṁ—
verses.english: “But monk, are you able to train in three trainings:
the higher ethics, the higher mind, and the higher wisdom?”
“So, monk, you should train in these three trainings:
the higher ethics, the higher mind, and the higher wisdom.

verses.pali: Yato kho tvaṁ, bhikkhu, adhisīlampi sikkhissasi, adhicittampi sikkhissasi, adhipaññampi sikkhissasi, tassa tuyhaṁ bhikkhu adhisīlampi sikkhato adhicittampi sikkhato adhipaññampi sikkhato rāgo pahīyissati, doso pahīyissati, moho pahīyissati.
verses.english: As you train in these, you will give up greed, hate, and delusion.

verses.pali: So tvaṁ rāgassa pahānā dosassa pahānā mohassa pahānā yaṁ akusalaṁ na taṁ karissasi, yaṁ pāpaṁ na taṁ sevissasī”ti.
verses.english: Then you won’t do anything unskillful, or practice anything bad.”

verses.pali: Atha kho so bhikkhu aparena samayena adhisīlampi sikkhi, adhicittampi sikkhi, adhipaññampi sikkhi.
verses.english: After some time that monk trained in the higher ethics, the higher mind, and the higher wisdom.

verses.pali: Tassa adhisīlampi sikkhato adhicittampi sikkhato adhipaññampi sikkhato rāgo pahīyi, doso pahīyi, moho pahīyi.
verses.english: He gave up greed, hate, and delusion.

verses.pali: So rāgassa pahānā dosassa pahānā mohassa pahānā yaṁ akusalaṁ taṁ nākāsi, yaṁ pāpaṁ taṁ na sevīti.
verses.english: Then he didn’t do anything unskillful, or practice anything bad.
